book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu na mitumi bhaki komi na bhabheli
Yesu akabhalohiki pamu bhabhulwa bhaki komi na bhabheli, na kubhapekeha uwezu wa kutopola majobhi, na kulamiha bhandu hitamu yabhu, na uzaifu wa kila ntundu.
Mahina gha mitumi komi na bhabheli habha nde agha: Wa kutumbula nde Simoni joalowakeka Petulu, na Andulea ndongu waki, Yakobo mwana waka Zebedayo, na Yohana ndongu waki,
Filipo na Batolomayo, Tomaso na Matayo joakabhi njopa kode, Yakobo mwana waka Alufayo, na Tadayo,
Simoni mkomanela inchi jaki, na Yuda Isikalioti najombi nde jola joakang'anambwiki Yesu.
Yesu abhatuma mitumi komi na bhabheli
Bhanihabha komi na bhabheli Yesu akabhatumiki na kubhapekeha lujiniku, akabhapwaghila, “Ngamwijenda kwa bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude, wala ngamwijingila mu michi ja Bhasamalia.
Nambu njendaje kwa bhandu bha Izilaeli, kwa ndandi bhabhili ngati mambeleli ghaghahobhike.
Panjenda, mkatangaza ana: ‘Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde uheghalile!’
Mwalamihaje bhatamwa, mwayoha bhakuwa, mwalamiha bhabhabhi na malohi, mukabhoha majobhi. Mpatiki waka, mboha waka.
Ngamwitogho zahabu, wala mbija, wala lingengalema la shaba mu mifuku jinu.
Ngamwitogho mikoba ja mwanja, wala likoti la kabheli, wala ndonga. Maghambu mtumika apalika kupata ghala ghaaghapala kwa kila lichobha.
“Muchi wokapi au chijiji chokapi chemwijingalaje, mkalondaje nde nane monihomu mundu joapala kunjopalela, mkatama kwaki mbaka pamwibhokaje.
Pamwijingala munyumba, mwalamuha bhenehi bhake, mkalamukyaje, ‘Lukwali lubya kwinu.’
Ngati bhenehi bha nyumba heji bhunjopalile, bhela, lukwali lwinu analutama papamu nabhu. Nambu ngati ngabhunjopalele, bhela, lukwali lwinu analunkelabhukya mwabhene.
Ngati mundu jokapi anaakaniki kunjopalela au kunjowanela, bhela pamwipita mu nyumba jeniheji au muchi ghonihoghu, mkung'undaje luhombi mumagolu ghinu.
Numpwaghi chakaka, lichobha lela Chapanga paanatemula bhandu, muchi ghonihoghu anaupata utemulu ukolongwa kupeta muchi wa Sodoma na Gomola.
Mang'ahiku ghaghahika
“Ndingalyaje! Nepani nuntuma mwehapa ngati mambeleli pachilanda ja mabweha gha muchitengu. Mbyaje na mbulau ngati lijoka, na mbya mabhandu bhapole ngati ngunda.
Mulilingalya na bhandu, maghambu anabhumpelaka kuchengu na kundapu iboku munyumba ya kuhimanganila Bhayahude.
Anabhumpelaka palongi ja bhajemalela na bhakolongwa kwa ndandi jangu, nahuli kunilandila kwabhu na kwa bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude.
Nambu pabhumpelaka kuchengu, ngamwikubha na choghoi mwipwagha kike au kwa ntundu bhole, maghambu anampataje malobhi gha kupwagha chikahi chelachela.
Kwa ndandi nga mwehapa mwemwilongilaje, nambu nde Roho wa Atati winu joanalongila mkati jinu.
“Ndongu anaamboha ndongu waki nahuli akomakikaje, na tati anaambohaje mwana waki nahuli akomakikaje. Bhana anabhang'anambukya bhabheleka bhabhu, na kubhakoma.
Bhandu bhokapi anabhunhakalyaje kwa ndandi ja lihina langu. Nambu joanahinakalya mbaka pakujomukela, anaakengaliwaje.
Bhandu pabhantopula mu muchi ghumu, mtililaye ku muchi ghongi. Chakaka numpwaghila, ngamwijomoli kujipetela michi jokapi ja Izilaeli, mangani Mwana waka Mundu ngacheahikiki.
“Nga mbulwa joampeta mbola waki, wala mtumwa ngacheampeta bambo waki.

Nambu ijaghanila kwaka mbulwa kulengana na mbola waki na mtumika kulengana na bambo waki. Ngati bhundohiki nkolongwa wa nyumba Beelizebuli, bho, bhandu bhala bhabhabhi munyumba heji ngabhilowakeki mahina ghangi mahakau nakanope?
Joapalika kujoghopwa
“Bhela, ngamwajoghopa bhandu. Kila chindu chekiyekaliki anachiyekuliwaje, na kila chindu chechilihiiki anachibhonikanaje.
Lenumpwaghila mwehapa mu lwihi, mulipwaghaye mu unang'anu. Na lijambu lemulijowini nukunjojalyaje, mulitangaza palongi ja bhandu.
Ngamwajoghopa bhandu bhala bhabhakoma hyegha, nambu ngachebhaweza kujikoma roho. Mbanga nakanopi kunjoghopa jola joaweza kukoma hyegha papamu na roho mu moto wa jehanamu.
Bho, ijuni ibheli ya iwebha ngacheilombeswa kwa sendi jimo? Nambu hata chimu chaki ngachekihabhuka pahi panga Atati winu wa kunani kumahunde kumanya.
Nambu hata kwinu mwehapa majunju gha kumutu jinu ghabhalangiki ghokapi.
Bhela, ngamwijoghopa, kwa ndandi mwehapa mpalika nakanopi kupeta iwebha yamaheli.
Kunjetakela na kunkana Kristo
“Kila mundu joanyetakela nepanu palongi ja bhandu, nanatu bhelabhela ananunjetakyaje palongi ja Atati wangu joabhi kunani kumahunde.
Nambu kila mundu joangana nepanu palongi ja bhandu, nanatu bhelabhela ananunkanaje palongi ja Atati wangu joabhi kunani kumahunde.
Nga lukwali, nambu lipanga
“Ngamwiholakela kubha nhikiki kuleta lukwali pundema. Nepanu ngachenhikiki kuleta lukwali, nambu lipanga.
Maghambu nhikiki kuleta ulekanganu mundu na atati waki, na kamwali na mabhu waki, na mwali na nkowanu waki wa chimbomba,
na maadui bhaka mundu nde bhandu bhala bhabhabhi munyumba jaki.
“Mundu jokapi joampala atati waki au mabhu waki kupeta nepanu ngacheapalika kubha mbulwa wangu. Na mundu jokapi joampala mwana waki au kamwali waki kupeta nepanu, ngacheapalika kubha mbulwa wangu.
Mundu jwangakuutotola msalaba waki na kunyengalela, ngacheapalika kubha mbulwa wangu.
Maghambu mundu joapala kuulenda womi waki anaauhoaje, nambu mundu jola joanauhoa womi waki kwa ndandi jangu, anaaupata kabheti.
Nhupu kwa bhabhunhobhale Yesu
“Mundu jokapi joanaanjopalya mwehapa anyopali nepanu, na mundu jokapi joanyopalela nepanu anaabya anjopali jola joandumiki.

Mundu joanjopalela mlota waka Chapanga kwa ndandi nde mlota waka Chapanga, anapata nhupu wa mlota waka Chapanga. Na mundu joanjopalela mundu wamboni kwa ndandi nde wamboni, anapata nhupu waka mundu wamboni.
Numpwaghi chakaka, mundu jokapi jonaampekya jumu wa bhachoku abhabha chikombi cha machi mahimu kwa ndandi nde mbulwa wangu, chakaka ngaalepi kupata nhupu waki ng'o.”
